name: Simultaneous Color Holography via End-to-End Optimization
definition: A method for generating holograms that form a full RGB image using a single SLM pattern illuminated simultaneously by red, green, and blue light sources, eliminating the need for field sequential color or multiple SLMs.
summary: Simultaneous Color Holography generates full RGB holograms from a single SLM pattern via end-to-end optimization, distinguishing itself by avoiding sequential color or multiple devices.
